title: Ninyas Zames (Gilgamesh)
summary: Son of Semiramis I and Ninus (Nimrod) in the chroniclers; CFAH identifies him with Gilgamesh.
description: Son of Semiramis I and Ninus (Nimrod) in the chroniclers; CFAH identifies him with Gilgamesh. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670, section "AP-47: The Reign of Ninyas Zames/Gilgamesh: 2006–1968 B.C."
reign.note: Sole reign from 1994 B.C. (AP-47 is on the event reign-of-ninyas-gilgamesh).
